headline: No votes taken; discussion covered quarterly reports from commissions and possible future items, including public television and Zoom rooms.
summary: No public comment was given, and there were no agenda, new, or unfinished business items. The chair said he will submit quarterly reports from the technology commission, IT manager, and town clerk to Council Leadership. No votes were taken.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
IT & CIVIC ENGAGEMENT 
COMMITTEE 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Doug Foley 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Grace Teodosio 
Committee Members: 
Present - Tom Figlar 
Absent - Tameeka Parks 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Ex-Officio Voting: 
Absent - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader  
Ex-Officio Non-Voting 
Absent - Katie Kiely, President   
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
IT & Civic Engagement Meeting, September 14, 2026 – 7:00pm.  The meeting was called 
to order at 8:48pm with the members noted above in attendance.   
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION No one gave public comment 
No one came forward to give public comment.  Public Input was closed at 8:50pm.  
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Chair Foley shared that he has had conversations with the chair of the technology 
commission, the IT manager, as well as the town clerk, about providing quarterly reports 
and he is already receiving them.  He noted that he will submit those to Council 
Leadership for the next committee meeting. 
 
Chair Foley noted the next scheduled meeting of the Technology Commission and 
commented on their great work, and their collaboration with the IT manager.  He said, “I'm 
very excited about all of the conversations going on there.” 
  
4. COMMITTEE REGULAR AGENDA 
There were no items on the regular agenda for this evening’s meeting.  
5. COMMITTEE NEW BUSINESS 
There were no new business items for this evening’s meeting.  
6. COMMITTEE UNFINISHED BUSINESS 
There were no unfinished business items for this evening’s meeting.  
8. POTENTIAL UPCOMING COMMITTEE ITEMS 
Chair Foley mentioned these upcoming items and noted his passion for improving 
efficiency of operations, especially as it pertains to Civic engagement. 
  1. Public Television Circuit 
  2. Software Training and Updates – improve our ability to share info w/the public. 
  3. Additional Zoom Rooms 
  4. Boards and Commission Links
TECHNOLOGY COMMISSION 
Complete 2026 Schedule - Recent Agendas & Minutes 
 ADJOURN 
With no additional business before the Committee, Chair Foley adjourned the meeting at 
8:53pm
